---
title: Portals
description: Keep portaled panels inside the Theme and document context that styles them.
section: Themes
order: 4
---

Foldkit anchored UI panels share `#foldkit-portal-root` in their containing Document or ShadowRoot. A root `Theme.view({ settings, isRoot: true }, children, h)` automatically inserts this shared portal root as the first child; do not add a second one manually. Portaled content then inherits the root Theme's CSS variables, appearance, and color settings. This illustrative fragment assumes `Theme`, `settings`, `h`, and `appContent` come from the enclosing application.

```ts fragment
Theme.view({ settings, isRoot: true }, [appContent], h)
```

A nested Theme can override the shared root's portal settings only while the panel is visible. `DropdownMenu` is a namespace: import it from `@wsagency/wseffect-themes` and call `DropdownMenu.create<Item>()` to obtain a bundle, then use that bundle's `embed`. The following is an illustrative fragment; `h`, `settings`, `menuModel`, `menuInputs`, and the parent Message mapping come from the enclosing app.

```ts fragment
const Actions = DropdownMenu.create<'edit' | 'delete'>()
const panel = Actions.embed(h, {
  slotId: 'actions',
  model: menuModel,
  toParentMessage: (message) => ({ _tag: 'MenuMessage' as const, message }),
  viewInputs: { ...menuInputs, themeSettings: settings },
})
```
